qualification.reason: The document is a Request for Quotes (RFQ) issued by the New York State Department of Taxation and Finance for GPS hardware and software, including submission deadlines, requirements, and evaluation criteria.

quotes.quote: REQUEST FOR QUOTES
BID DUE DATE: October 8, 2019
REQUEST FOR QUOTE NUMBER: 19-326
The Department anticipates an initial order of ninety-three (93) GPS devices to be installed at three (3) different locations within New York State.
Deadline for Submission of Quotes (Cover Page and Attachments 1-4) October 8, 2019 by 2:00 PM ET
Responses to this RFQ must be emailed to BFS.Contracts@tax.ny.gov no later than October 8, 2019 at 2:00 PM ET.
The award will be made to the responsive and responsible Bidder who provides the lowest overall cost and meets all requirements set forth in this RFQ.

findings.business_implication: Contractor bears the cost of maintenance/replacement for non-negligent issues, potentially significant financial exposure.
findings.action_recommendation: Factor this into pricing and risk assessment.

findings.fact: The Bidder must be the original manufacturer or authorized reseller of the hardware and software to be provided.
findings.business_implication: Only manufacturers or authorized resellers can bid; resellers must provide proof of authorization.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify that your company is an authorized reseller for the proposed GPS hardware and software, and be prepared to provide documentation.

quotes.quote: The Bidder must: • Be the original manufacturer or authorized reseller of the hardware and software to be provided; and • Be compliant with all applicable laws and regulations related to providing these services.

findings.fact: The Bidder must be compliant with all applicable laws and regulations related to providing these services.
findings.business_implication: Bidders must ensure they have all necessary licenses and permits to provide GPS hardware and software services in New York State.
findings.action_recommendation: Review and confirm compliance with all federal, state, and local laws relevant to the services.

quotes.quote: The Bidder must: • Be the original manufacturer or authorized reseller of the hardware and software to be provided; and • Be compliant with all applicable laws and regulations related to providing these services.

findings.title: Prohibition on Purchase of Tropical Hardwoods
findings.fact: The Contractor certifies and warrants that all wood products to be used under this contract award will be in accordance with Section 165 of the State Finance Law, which prohibits purchase and use of tropical hardwoods unless specifically exempted. The bid may not be considered responsive if not in compliance.
findings.business_implication: Bidder must ensure no tropical hardwoods are used in any supplied or installed products, or obtain an exemption, to avoid disqualification.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify that all hardware and installation materials comply with the tropical hardwood prohibition; if any wood products are used, confirm they are not tropical hardwoods or seek exemption approval from the State.

quotes.quote: The Contractor certifies and warrants that all wood products to be used under this contract award will be in accordance with, but not limited to, the specifications and provisions of Section 165 of the State Finance Law, (Use of Tropical Hardwoods) which prohibits purchase and use of tropical hardwoods, unless specifically exempted, by the State or any governmental agency or political subdivision or public benefit corporation.
Any such use must meet with the approval of the State; otherwise, the bid may not be considered responsive.

findings.title: MacBride Fair Employment Principles Certification
findings.fact: The Contractor must stipulate that it either has no business operations in Northern Ireland, or shall take lawful steps in good faith to conduct any business operations in Northern Ireland in accordance with the MacBride Fair Employment Principles, and shall permit independent monitoring of compliance.

findings.action_recommendation: Review company operations in Northern Ireland and prepare to certify compliance with MacBride principles or confirm no operations there.

quotes.quote: In accordance with the MacBride Fair Employment Principles (Chapter 807 of the Laws of 1992), the Contractor hereby stipulates that the Contractor either (a) has no business operations in Northern Ireland, or (b) shall take lawful steps in good faith to conduct any business operations in Northern Ireland in accordance with the MacBride Fair Employment Principles (as described in Section 165 of the New York State Finance Law), and shall permit independent monitoring of compliance with such principles.

quotes.quote: Bidders are hereby notified that if their principal place of business is located in a country, nation, province, state or political subdivision that penalizes New York State vendors, and if the goods or services they offer will be substantially produced or performed outside New York State, the Omnibus Procurement Act 1994 and 2000 amendments (Chapter 684 and Chapter 383, respectively) require that they be denied contracts which they would otherwise obtain.
